+function to24Time(raw){
+ const m=String(raw||'').trim().match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)$/i);
+ if(!m)return'';
+ let h=Number(m[1]),min=m[2],ap=m[3].toUpperCase();
+ if(ap==='AM'&&h===12)h=0;if(ap==='PM'&&h!==12)h+=12;
+ return String(h).padStart(2,'0')+':'+min;
+}
+function from24Time(raw){
+ const m=String(raw||'').match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);if(!m)return'';
+ let h=Number(m[1]),min=m[2],ap=h>=12?'PM':'AM';h=h%12||12;return h+':'+min+' '+ap;
+}
+function parsedBlockTimes(b){
+ let start=customTokenValue(b,'START:'),end=customTokenValue(b,'END:');
+ if(start||end)return{start,end};
+ const t=String(b.time||'').replace(/—/g,'–').trim();
+ let m=t.match(/^(\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)?\s*[–-]\s*(\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)$/i);
+ if(m){
+   const endAp=m[4].toUpperCase();
+   const startAp=(m[2]||endAp).toUpperCase();
+   start=to24Time(m[1]+' '+startAp);end=to24Time(m[3]+' '+endAp);
+   return{start,end};
+ }
+ m=t.match(/^(\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)$/i);
+ if(m){start=to24Time(m[1]+' '+m[2]);return{start,end:''}}
+ return{start:'',end:''};
+}
+function blockDisplayTime(b){
+ const {start,end}=parsedBlockTimes(b);

+ if(end)return 'Until '+from24Time(end);
+ return 'Choose time';
